body:
GitHub issue #821.

PROBLEM
plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/session-state.mjs withStateLock calls Atomics.wait for backoffMs and then unconditionally runs a busy-spin loop for another backoffMs on every contended retry.

BUILD
1. In plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/session-state.mjs, accept an optional `wait = Atomics.wait` parameter in withStateLock and only run the fallback Date.now() busy-spin loop when `typeof wait !== "function"`.
2. Rebuild plugins/adlc-cursor/bin/adlc-mcp-wrapper.bundle.mjs via `npm run build:cursor-mcp`.
3. Add unit tests in plugins/adlc-cursor/test/session-state-dir.test.mjs verifying that contended retries use `wait` without double-sleeping when available and fall back to the busy-spin when `wait` is not a function.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC1: withStateLock calls `wait` without running the busy-spin fallback when `wait` is a function, and falls back to spinning when `wait` is not a function. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/session-state-dir.test.mjs`
- AC2: Packaging bundle check and session-state tests pass. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/session-state-dir.test.mjs plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs`
title: plugin(adlc-cursor): avoid unconditional busy-spin after Atomics.wait in withStateLock (#821)
